simple.meaning: בִּכּוּרָה (bikkûwrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “the early fig.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בִּכּוּרָה (H1063) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Hosea 9:10, with occurrences in Hosea, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּכּוּרָה (H1063) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בִּכּוּרָה (H1063) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בִּכּוּרָה (bikkûwrâh) / H1063 is traced through Hosea 9:10, Micah 7:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1063. bikkurah בִּכּוּרָה noun feminine first ripe fig, early fig (regarded as a delicacy) (Löw 391 ; compare Arabic , Spanish albacora , Moorish bokkôre ) Micah 7:1 ; Hosea 9:10 ; suffix בִּכּוּרָהּ = בִּכּוּרָתָהּ (read בִּכּוּרָה Di), Isa 28:4 ; plural בַּכֻּרוֺת Jer 24:2 **probably a different word, plural abstract = early ripeness , compare Du.

occurrences.englishText: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness.
